description: This file defines a frontend UI component named 'Shop' for a shopping application, built using the Lightning.js framework. It includes component layout, state management, event handling, and subscribes to a cart store for dynamic updates.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: Base class from Lightning.js framework used to create UI components.

methods.name: $toggleCart
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the shopping cart panel.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that subscribes to cart store updates and initializes cart state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Lifecycle hook to clean up subscriptions when component is detached.
